summary: Self-review: the rework PR title+body refresh is correct, complete, minimal, and idiomatic — all 7 acceptance criteria met, gates green on independent re-run; no correctness findings, three non-blocking observations.

observations.summary: knip.json adds 'lefthook' to ignoreDependencies — a pre-existing, feature-unrelated build-tooling fix (package.json/lefthook.yml byte-identical to base); needed for the lint gate, follows the file's 21-entry convention, one line, reversible.

Rework body falls back to a stub 'PR for: <title>' if pr-description.md is missing; cannot occur on the normal path (prDescription runs first and blocks on needs_human) and mirrors the existing creation-path fallback. Non-issue.

The pr-description prompt instruction that makes the agent write pr-title.md (the title feature's linchpin) has no test guarding it; a future edit dropping it would silently revert titles to the task title with no test failure. Prompt-content assertions are not a project convention and the fallback is tested, so this is an optional regression-guard suggestion, not a gap. Concrete fix: assert buildInstructions(dir) contains 'pr-title.md' in delivery.test.ts.
